deadline.value: The encouraged deadline is January 1 for internal fellowship eligibility; reviews begin January 1.
deadline.quote: URI-GSO has a rolling admission with an encouraged deadline of January 1st to be eligible for URI internal fellowships

gre_general.value: No GREs are required; recent TOEFL scores are required for applicants whose first language is not English.
gre_general.quote: No GREs required, though recent TOEFL scores, or equivalent, are required for students whose first language is not English

supervisor.value: Applicants are not accepted without a faculty sponsor who agrees to act as their temporary advisor.
supervisor.quote: Students will not be accepted into the URI-GSO Graduate Program without a faculty sponsor

funding.value: Admission depends on identified funding; qualified applicants without funding are waitlisted.
funding.quote: applicants that meet our merit based admissions but for whom funding source have not been identified will be waitlisted

entry_route.value: The GSO admission page does not state a degree requirement for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Oceanography PhD with biological, chemical, geological and physical tracks. The stipend for 2026-2027 is $42,393 to $45,497 by level, per the GSO page. The same catalog page also lists Ocean Engineering PhD; no separate Ocean Engineering admissions rules were saved.
